name: Cinderheart Citadel
difficulty_label: Hard • lava castle, three minibosses and an awakening below the throne
description: Enter an ember-crowned fortress of ash courtyards, sealed archives, turquoise ashglass laboratories and chain-driven crucibles. Follow iron-decked stone bridges over molten rivers to the phoenix-carved crown chamber. Heat scorches nearby explorers; shallow pools burn and deep lava rivers are fatal. Break three wardens, dethrone Castellan Varr, then survive what wakes beneath his throne.
